items.claim: Q4 FY2026: Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended 3 September 2026, reported 30 September 2026): revenue $54.23 billion vs $41.46 billion in Q3 and $11.32 billion a year earlier; GAAP net income $37.70 billion ($32.87 per diluted share), non-GAAP $38.40 billion ($33.42 per share); operating cash flow $43.97 billion. Full year FY2026 (53 weeks): revenue $133.19 billion (FY2025: $37.38 billion), GAAP EPS $74.33, non-GAAP EPS $75.52. Consensus was about $31.41 EPS on $50.86 billion revenue, and revenue also exceeded Micron's own $50.0 billion +/- $1.0 billion guide. Quarterly dividend $0.15. The stock slipped about 3% the next day.

N.D. Cal. (Garciaguirre v. Samsung Electronics): consumer class action filed 25 June 2026 alleging a Sherman Act conspiracy by Samsung, SK hynix and Micron to cut conventional DRAM output; motion to dismiss denied 14 November 2026, answer due 7 December 2026; no finding on the merits, Micron denies

Netlist patent dispute: E.D. Tex. jury found willful infringement and awarded $445 million (23 May 2024); settled in October 2026 with Micron paying $600 million over five years for a licence and both sides seeking dismissal of all pending proceedings including ITC 337-TA-1523
Munich I Regional Court found Micron infringed two YMTC German utility models and issued first-instance sales injunctions for Germany; Micron has appealed to the Munich Higher Regional Court
D.D.C. (No. 1:25-cv-01795): YMTC Lanham Act / false-advertising suit over the 'China Tech Threat' campaign dismissed with prejudice (13 or 14 August 2026) as political, not commercial, speech

D. Idaho (In re Micron Technology Inc. Securities Litigation, No. 1:25-cv-00191-BLW): securities class action alleging concealed consumer/NAND demand deterioration; amended complaint dismissed 3 February 2026, lead plaintiffs voluntarily dismissed 3 April 2026
N.D. Cal. (YMTC v. Micron, 3:23-cv-05792): YMTC 3D NAND patent infringement suit filed 9 November 2023; reported stayed pending inter partes review

Cyberspace Administration of China: Micron products failed a cybersecurity review citing 'serious network security risks'; critical information infrastructure operators barred from buying them (no specific technical finding published; restriction remains in effect)
N.D. Cal. / Ninth Circuit (No. 21-15125): 2018 DRAM indirect-purchaser Sherman Act class action dismissed, affirmed on appeal 7 March 2022

Micron and UMC global settlement of trade-secret/patent disputes, ending matters including the 2018 Fuzhou court preliminary injunction against two Micron China subsidiaries; UMC made a one-time payment to Micron
Virginia Department of Environmental Quality: Micron agreed to pay $157,101 over volatile organic compound emissions exceeding permit limits at its Manassas facility
China SAMR investigation into possible collusion by DRAM suppliers, with unannounced visits to Micron sales offices on 31 May 2018; no decision, fine or closure found; status unknown
U.S. civil DRAM price-fixing cases: Micron and five other DRAM makers agreed a $173 million settlement with indirect purchasers and 33 state attorneys general (Micron's individual share not found)

European Commission cartel settlement decision fining nine DRAM producers EUR 331 million for the 1998-2002 cartel; Micron was an addressee but received full immunity from fines as the leniency applicant (it also received full amnesty in the U.S. DOJ investigation)
